units.source_text: 当时历代皇后都是藤原氏一族的人，故云。

en.t: At that time, successive empresses were all members of the Fujiwara clan, so it is said this way.

units.source_text: 但皇族赐姓时，大都赐姓源氏，故此处将皇族概称为源氏。

en.t: However, when members of the imperial family were granted surnames, they were usually given the surname Minamoto, so here the imperial family is referred to collectively as the Minamoto clan.
